name: Cardinal
description: Virtual modular synthesizer plugin based on VCV Rack.
about:
Cardinal brings the VCV Rack module ecosystem into a plugin. Patch oscillators, filters, sequencers and effects with virtual cables, and run it inside any DAW as VST3 or CLAP.

It bundles a large set of open-source Rack modules and is a free way to try modular patching in a session.
